subject.title: fix(android): restore the complete Wear companion experience

question: Should OpenClaw support the complete five-page Wear companion interface, including phone-proxied agent selection and gateway connect/disconnect controls, as the maintained Android/Wear product contract?
rationale: The branch is substantially larger than a visual restoration: it establishes new companion controls and paired-device RPC semantics that require owner confirmation of the intended durable surface.

options.title: Adopt the complete companion contract
options.body: Approve the restored scope after upgrade and agent/session-state behavior is demonstrated against supported paired-app version combinations.

options.title: Narrow to the confirmed regression
options.body: Retain only the companion behavior already established by current Android/Wear product expectations and defer additional controls to a separately scoped change.

recommendation.title: Adopt the complete companion contract
recommendation.body: Approve the restored scope after upgrade and agent/session-state behavior is demonstrated against supported paired-app version combinations.

likelyOwner.reason: They can supply the implementation and physical-device evidence, while a current-main Android/Wear history pass should identify the final reviewing owner.
